synopsis: Gon leaves Whale Island to take the grueling Hunter Exam, hoping to find clues about his father, Ging. Along the way, he meets Killua, Kurapika, and Leorio.
After Killua is forced to return home, Gon, Kurapika, and Leorio travel to the perilous Kukuroo Mountain to rescue their friend from his family of deadly assassins.
Gon and Killua head to Heavens Arena to train and earn money. Here they meet Wing, who teaches them the fundamental principles of Nen, the life-energy technique.
The main cast reunites in Yorknew City for the world's largest mafia auction. Kurapika hunts down the Phantom Troupe to avenge the Kurta Clan.
Gon and Killua enter the deadly real-world video game created by Ging. They train under Biscuit Krueger to master their Nen and complete the game.
A highly adaptive and terrifying species of ants begins consuming humans and evolving. The Hunter Association mobilizes its strongest members to stop the Ant King.
Following Netero's death, the Zodiacs gather to elect a new chairman. Meanwhile, Killua races against time with his sister Alluka to save a dying Gon.
Beyond the known world lies the Dark Continent, a place of ultimate danger and unimaginable resources. Beyond Netero leads an unauthorized expedition, forcing the Zodiacs to act.
Aboard the Black Whale en route to the Dark Continent, the 14 princes of the Kakin Empire engage in a brutal battle royale for the throne. Kurapika is caught in the middle.
